metadata.case_name: CHOW WAI TING v. LI KA WAH AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: trained garment worker (piece time) for Wing Fung Company

injuries.description: Fracture superior and inferior pubic rami of pelvis on left side
source: Fracture superior and inferior pubic rami of pelvis on left side
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring
Fracture of neck of femur, unspecified

injuries.description: Abrasion over the left trochanteric region.
source: Abrasion over the left trochanteric region.

injuries.description: Nasty cut on her right elbow with resultant scar
source: she claims to have suffered a nasty cut on her right elbow and she showed the court the resultant scar.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of forearm

injuries.description: Avascular necrosis of the head of the right femur
source: X-Ray of the right hip showed avascular necrosis of the head of the right femur.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

source: it is inevitable that she will develop an Osteo-Arthritis of the hip.
signs of Osteo-Arthritis are already present on clinical examination.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: Pain with standing became severe (caused her to give up job as a salesgirl)
Restriction of movement of the hip
Unable to indulge in any sport which require standing, running or walking; can do only sedentary work

treatments_received: bilateral skin traction (temporary immobilisation of femoral fracture)
operative fixation by pinning of the neck fracture (performed on 1976-06-19)
well-leg traction for pelvis injury (taken off on 1976-07-30)
non-weight bearing exercises with crutches (allowed on 1976-08-11)
transfer to Margaret Trench Rehabilitation Centre for physiotherapy
treatments_future: possible blood transfusion if necessary during operation

losses.description: Ongoing pain, restriction of movement of the right hip and need for eventual hip replacement
Disfigurement of thigh and elbow (scar on right elbow and thigh disfigurement)
Disfigurement of thigh (abrasion over the left trochanteric region resulting in scarring)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to indulge in any sport which require standing, running or walking; can do only sedentary work
Could not return to old work operating a sewing machine; gave up job as a salesgirl due to pain on standing
